publisher: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
label: 影片 7
theme: Lili Reinhart 談 BTS MV 與新片《愛情假說》
themeEn: Lili Reinhart Was Nervous to Dance in BTS' SWIM Video, Talks Star Wars Fanfic for Love Hypothesis

ex.en: Lili: I did not. I've been in the middle of the press tour, so my birthday was at my house for two seconds between Europe and then here.
ex.zh: Lili：沒有。我正在跑宣傳行程，所以生日就是在歐洲和這裡之間，在家待了短短一下。

tips.t: press release 新聞稿；press conference 記者會（多益必考的 press 搭配）。

ex.en: Lili: Good question. Every now and then. There's some scary stuff in there, so I tend to shy away from that.
ex.zh: Lili：好問題。偶爾。裡面有些很可怕的東西，所以我通常會避開。

tips.t: shy away from risks／responsibility 迴避風險／責任。

pos.m: 令人畏懼的，讓人有壓力的

ex.en: Lili: It was a little intimidating. I mean, they're the biggest band of all time.
ex.zh: Lili：有點令人卻步。我是說，他們是史上最大的樂團。

tips.t: -ing 形容「令人～的」事物，-ed 形容「感到～的」人：The interview was intimidating. / I was intimidated.

ex.en: Lili: I know, and my first instinct was, "BTS is asking me to be in a music video. I can't dance at all."
ex.zh: Lili：我知道，我的第一個反應是：「BTS 找我拍 MV，但我完全不會跳舞。」

tips.t: first instinct 第一直覺；trust your instincts 相信直覺。

ex.en: Lili: Well, that was my fear. I was like, I'm gonna have to turn them down because I can't dance.
ex.zh: Lili：嗯，那就是我擔心的。我想說我得拒絕他們，因為我不會跳舞。

tips.t: turn down an offer／invitation 拒絕工作邀約／邀請（多益 Part 3 常考同義改寫：decline）。

ex.en: Lili: So I was like, I actually am gonna have to pass.
ex.zh: Lili：所以我想說，我真的得婉拒了。

tips.t: I'll pass. 我就不參加了（口語婉拒）；pass on an offer 放棄某個機會。

ex.en: I got to say congratulations, because this is a big deal. You got nominated for one of Cleveland's most interesting people of 2026.
ex.zh: 我一定要恭喜你，因為這是大事。你被提名為 2026 年克里夫蘭最有趣人物之一。

tips.t: be nominated for an award 被提名某獎項（員工表揚公告常見）。

ex.en: Lili: Yes. I mean, I share this honor with my friends there.
ex.zh: Lili：對。我是說，我和那裡的朋友一起分享這份榮耀。

tips.t: It is an honor to 很榮幸能～；in honor of 為了紀念／表揚～；honor a contract 履行合約。

ex.en: Jimmy: When you started auditioning for roles, what roles did you audition for?
ex.zh: Jimmy：你剛開始試鏡時，都試哪些角色？

tips.t: audition for a role 試鏡某個角色。

ex.en: I was a huge "Glee" fan, because I think the show takes place in Ohio.
ex.zh: 我是《歡樂合唱團》的超級粉絲，因為我記得那部劇的背景就在俄亥俄州。

tips.t: The conference will take place in May. 會議將於五月舉行（多益公告、通知必考，同義 be held）。

ex.en: It's actually based on a "Star Wars" fan fiction?
ex.zh: 它其實是根據一篇《星際大戰》同人小說改編的？

fam: basis n. 基礎（Day 10 滿分單字）

tips.t: be based on 根據～；based in 以～為據點：a company based in Tokyo（Day 07 滿分單字）。

ex.en: So, it's Olive and Adam, and they fake date so that Olive's friend Anh will pursue the crush that she has.
ex.zh: 故事是 Olive 和 Adam，他們假裝交往，好讓 Olive 的朋友 Anh 能去追她暗戀的人。

tips.t: pursue a career in ～ 從事～職業；pursue a degree 攻讀學位。

ex.en: Did you do a lot of research and watch a lot of rom-coms?
ex.zh: 你有做很多功課、看很多愛情喜劇嗎？

tips.t: do／conduct research on 針對～做研究；research 當名詞不可數，不能說 a research。

ex.en: Jimmy: So, they actually released a Mountain Dew Baja Blast pie. This is limited, limited, limited edition. And this is just for you.
ex.zh: Jimmy：他們推出了 Mountain Dew Baja Blast 派，這是超級、超級限量版，專門給你的。

tips.t: release a new product 推出新產品；release date 發行日期（Day 07 滿分單字）；limited edition 限量版。

pos.m: 細節，具體事項（常用複數）

ex.en: We'll work on the specifics later.

tips.t: work out the specifics 敲定細節；go into specifics 談到細節。
